title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-rpj4: edhoc_module NameError in test_edhoc.py
description:
## Bug: edhoc_module NameError in test_edhoc.py

**Pre-existing issue discovered during review.**

**File:** `python/tests/crypto/test_edhoc.py`

**Locations:**
- Line 451: `monkeypatch.setattr(edhoc_module, "_x25519_shared_secret", unexpected_dh)` — `edhoc_module` is undefined
- Line 526: `monkeypatch.setattr(edhoc_module, "VerifyKey", RejectingVerifyKey)` — `edhoc_module` is undefined

Both tests need `import lichen.crypto.edhoc as edhoc_module` added to imports.

**Impact:** Two tests in `TestEdhocValidation` fail with `NameError` before they can even reach their assertions. These have been broken since the test was written.
